Kill 3 [[Prismatic Ooze]]s in the [[Ooze Pit]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in the [[Depths of Tyria]]. {{sic|Lists the region instead of the dungeon name}}
* *BONUS* Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Dwarf_Rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per the [[Watch it Jiggle#Walkthrough|Watch it Jiggle]] quest. At least one party member must have the quest in order to get past the locked gate in the dungeon.
